title: Settings
description: Configure model connections and Chat behavior
baseUrlRequired: Base URL is required for OpenAI-compatible services
parallelToolCallsHelp: Controls the API parallel_tool_calls parameter. Leave unset to use the provider default.
privacyNote: Raw reasoning and tool I/O are not sent to the browser by default. Disabling long-term memory does not delete existing memories or affect the current session history/summaries.
retriesHelp: Agno application-level retries for recoverable 429/5xx errors. 0 disables. Default 4.
delayBetweenRetriesHelp: Wait before the first retry; with exponential backoff later waits are 1x, 2x, 4x…
exponentialBackoffHelp: Double the delay after each failed attempt.
httpMaxRetriesHelp: OpenAI SDK max_retries. Leave empty for the SDK default; prefer request retries above.
deleteActiveModelHint: This is the active model. Another model will be selected after deletion.
cannotDeleteBuiltin: Built-in models cannot be deleted; disable them instead
liveSearchHelp: Sends search_parameters when supported (native xAI; OpenAI-compatible via extra_body). Ignored for DeepSeek and native OpenAI.
liveSearchUnsupported: Live Search is only applied for xAI and OpenAI-compatible gateways.
xaiReasoningHint: xAI does not use reasoning_effort; pick a reasoning or non-reasoning model id.
baseUrlOptional: Optional for native providers (uses official default)
autoDefaultsHint: Protocol, structured output, reasoning, retries, and Live Search use optimal provider defaults. Toggle Live Search / Knowledge per turn in Chat.
usersHint: Assign product roles (analyst / author / approver / auditor). Users must re-login to refresh JWT scopes.
roleDesc_analyst: Investigate, chat, run workflows; no system config writes
roleDesc_author: Build workflows, knowledge, and skill submissions
roleDesc_approver: Resolve HITL and review run context
cannotDemoteSuperuser: Do not demote superusers here; clear the superuser flag first.
